description: SQLhandler vs EzPresto benchmark workload on the G2 cluster MinIO test-parquet data. rows_scanned = source rows the engine must touch. queries.ezpresto holds catalog-qualified SQL (filled in after SHOW CATALOGS probe); when absent the harness reuses the sqlhandler SQL.

queries.sqlhandler: SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM sales_employees
SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM sales_orders WHERE order_id BETWEEN 100000 AND 100099
SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(qty) AS s FROM sales_orders WHERE unit_price > 250 GROUP BY region
SELECT region, product, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(unit_price) AS a FROM sales_orders GROUP BY region, product
SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM sales_orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(o.qty * o.unit_price) AS rev FROM sales_orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

queries.name: count_big_3m
queries.note: full scan of 3M rows x 50 cols

queries.sqlhandler: SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM testdata_50col
SELECT SUM(quantity) AS s, AVG(returns_qty) AS a FROM testdata_50col
SELECT tenant_id, SUM(quantity) AS s FROM testdata_50col WHERE region_id = 11 GROUP BY tenant_id
SELECT COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(quantity) AS s, MAX(supplier_id) AS mx, MIN(brand_id) AS mn FROM testdata_50col
